summary.en: The last 13km to North Cape (E69) is CLOSED to individual traffic in winter. You must join a scheduled convoy (Kolonnekjøring) led by a snowplow.
summary.zh: 通往北角的最后 13 公里（E69公路）在冬季对个人交通封闭。您必须加入由扫雪车带领的定点车队（Kolonnekjøring）。

mitigations.en: Arrive at the meeting point (Skarsvåg junction) at least 15 mins before departure.
mitigations.zh: 至少在出发前 15 分钟到达集合点（Skarsvåg 路口）。

mitigations.en: Have enough fuel/battery and warm clothes in the car in case of waiting.
mitigations.zh: 车内需有足够的燃料/电量和保暖衣物，以防等待。

mitigations.en: If the weather is too severe, the convoy will be cancelled.
mitigations.zh: 如果天气太恶劣，车队护送将被取消。

items.zh: 手电筒/头灯（强制要求易于取用）
拖车绳和铲子（强烈推荐）

items.en: Full tank of fuel/Full charge (no gas station at the cape)
items.zh: 满油/满电（北角海角没有加油站）

items.en: Check convoy times (usually 11:00 and 13:00, subject to change)
items.zh: 检查车队出发时间（通常是 11:00 和 13:00，可能会变动）

message.en: In a convoy: Keep eye contact with the car in front. Use hazard lights if you stop. Never leave the line. Do not turn on fog lights unless necessary (blinds others).
message.zh: 在车队中：保持看到前车。如果停车请使用双闪灯。永远不要离开队列。除非必要，不要打开雾灯（会晃瞎他人）。
